blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — A 78-year-old man was found dead after a tree branch fell on him in a remote area of Dapdap Sur, Barangay Talisay, Daanbantayan, on Tuesday afternoon, September 29. The victim was identified as alias “Michael,” 78, married, and a resident of Sitio Dapdap, Barangay Talisay. The Daanbantayan Municipal Police Station received a report about a body found in an isolated area in Dapdap Sur.
